intro: How to complain about a faulty product and how a formal letter is organised.
p.reclamación.consejo: It comes from «reclamar», to ask for what is yours. The usual verb is «presentar»: «presentar una reclamación».
p.hoja de reclamaciones.consejo: You ask for it in shops and bars with «¿Me da una hoja de reclamaciones?». It is an official form.
p.reembolso.consejo: The usual verb is «pedir»: «pedir un reembolso». It starts with «ree-»: two e's in a row, pronounced separately.
p.devolver.consejo: The o becomes ue: «devuelvo», «devuelven», but «devolvemos». «Devolver el dinero» means giving a refund.
p.avería.consejo: The accent on the i splits «a-ve-rí-a» into four syllables. You say «tener una avería».
p.estropeado.consejo: It changes with what it describes: «estropeado», «estropeada». The verb is «estropear».
p.garantía.consejo: If the product fails during the «garantía», you can claim. Always keep the receipt.
p.recibo.consejo: You ask for it and keep it: «¿me da el recibo, por favor?». Without a receipt it is harder to complain.
p.reparar.consejo: It starts with «re-», again, and sounds rre-pa-RAR. Its noun is «reparación».
p.lavadora.consejo: It comes from «lavar». The v sounds like b: la-ba-DO-ra. The dish one is the «lavavajillas».
p.cliente.consejo: For a woman you can also say «clienta». «El cliente siempre tiene razón» is a well-known saying.
p.sin embargo.consejo: It marks a contrast and usually comes first, with a comma: «Sin embargo, llegó rota».
p.por eso.consejo: It introduces the result of what came before: «Está roto; por eso reclamo».
p.además.consejo: It adds one more idea. It has an accent, a-de-MAS, like «detrás» or «también».
b1.texto:
In person you can say: **Quiero presentar una reclamación** or **¿Me da una hoja de reclamaciones?** Explain the problem with short sentences: **No funciona. Está estropeado.** And say what you want: **Quiero que me devuelvan el dinero.**

A formal complaint letter has these parts:

1. Greeting: **Estimados señores:**
2. Reason: **Me dirijo a ustedes para** + infinitive.
3. Facts: **El pasado 3 de mayo compré**…
4. Problem and sequence: **sin embargo**, **además**, **por eso**.
5. Request: **Les ruego que** + subjunctive.
6. Closing: **Quedo a la espera de su respuesta. Atentamente,**

This lesson teaches the language of asking; the outcome of a complaint depends on each case.
b2.f0.texto: I want to make a complaint.
b2.f2.texto: The washing machine I bought here is broken.
b2.f3.texto: Do you have the receipt for the purchase?
b2.f4.texto: Yes, and the warranty lasts two years.
b2.f5.texto: Then we will repair it for free.
b2.f6.texto: I do not want a repair, I want you to give me my money back.
b2.f7.texto: For that I need you to fill in the complaint form.
b2.f8.texto: Thanks, I am already filling it in.
b2.f9.texto: You will receive a reply within ten days.
b4.titulo: The formal letter: me dirijo, les ruego que
b4.texto:
A complaint letter uses fixed formulas:

- **Me dirijo a ustedes para** + infinitive: you give the reason. **Me dirijo a ustedes para presentar una reclamación.**
- **Sin embargo**, **además** and **por eso** organise the facts: contrast, addition and consequence.
- **Les ruego que** + subjunctive: a formal request. **Les ruego que me devuelvan el dinero.**

**Ustedes** is used because you write to a company, that is, to several people. To close: **Quedo a la espera de su respuesta. Atentamente,**
b4.e0.texto: I am writing to you to make a complaint.
b4.e1.texto: However, the washing machine arrived broken.
b4.e2.texto: I ask you to give me my money back as soon as possible.
b5.f0.texto: The new washing machine falls still in the middle of the kitchen.
b5.f1.texto: A puddle of soapy water shines under the window light.
b5.f2.texto: Lucía looks at the switched-off light and listens to the silence of the house.
b5.f3.texto: Outside, a boy plays with a red ball in the yard.
b5.f4.texto: The breakdown has left the clothes wet inside the drum.
b5.f5.texto: An hour later the doorbell rings.
b5.f6.texto: A technician with big hands comes in with a toolbox.
b5.f7.texto: He kneels next to the washing machine and opens a small door at the bottom.
b5.f8.texto: The dirty water drips slowly into a blue bucket.
b5.f9.texto: In the end, the technician smiles and promises that it will work well tomorrow.
b6.frase: Les ruego que me ____ el dinero.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! A request takes the subjunctive: «devuelvan».
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is the ordinary present, with no request. The subjunctive is needed here.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive does not work after «que»: a conjugated verb is needed.
b7.o0.refuerzo: The receipt proves you paid. The form is for complaining.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That is it! It is an official form to make a complaint.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The warranty is a promise to repair. It is not a form.
b8.frase: Me dirijo a ustedes para presentar una reclamación
b8.traduccion: I am writing to you to make a complaint
b9.o0.refuerzo: «En oferta» means with a reduced price. «Estropeada» is something else.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Switched on means it has power. «Estropeada» means it fails.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes! «Estropeado» means it no longer works as it should.
b9.pregunta: The washing machine is «estropeada». What is happening?
b10.frase: Me ____ a ustedes para presentar una reclamación.
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Dirige» is for «él» or «usted». Here «yo» is speaking.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Well done! «Yo me dirijo»: the g changes to j before o.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Decir» is not used in this letter formula.
b10.pregunta: Which form of «dirigirse» do you need?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes! «Sin embargo» opposes two ideas, like «pero».
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Además» adds an idea; it does not contradict.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Por eso» introduces a consequence, not a contrast.
b13.frase: La lavadora no funciona: tiene una ____.
b13.o0.refuerzo: A reply is what the company answers, not a fault.
b13.o1.refuerzo: The warranty is a promise to repair, not the fault.
b13.o2.refuerzo: That is it! An «avería» is a fault in a machine.
b13.pregunta: Which word names a fault in the machine?
p.problema.consejo: It ends in -a but is masculine: «el problema».
p.dura.consejo: Here it is a verb: «dura dos años». As an adjective it means hard.
p.repararemos.consejo: Future of «reparar» for «nosotros». The stress is on -RE-.
p.gratis.consejo: It never changes: «gratis» for masculine, feminine and plural.
p.reparación.consejo: Noun of «reparar». Words in -ción are feminine and take an accent.
p.devuelvan.consejo: Subjunctive of «devolver». It goes after «que» in a request.
p.rellenando.consejo: Gerund of «rellenar». «Estoy rellenando» means I am filling in now.
p.recibirá.consejo: Future of «recibir» for «usted». The accent marks the last syllable.
p.dirijo.consejo: The g of «dirigir» becomes j before o: «dirijo».
p.llegó.consejo: Past (indefinido) of «llegar». The «ll» sounds like y.
p.ruego.consejo: «Les ruego que» is a formal request. The o becomes ue in «ruego».
p.quieta.consejo: Feminine of «quieto». «Quedarse quieta» is to stay still.
p.medio.consejo: «En medio de» means in the middle of: «en medio de la cocina».
p.jabonosa.consejo: It comes from «jabón». The j sounds like h.
p.piloto.consejo: It also means the person who flies a plane.
p.apagado.consejo: Participle of «apagar» used as an adjective: «piloto apagado».
p.pelota.consejo: A small ball for games. A big football is a «balón».
p.dejado.consejo: Participle of «dejar»: «ha dejado la ropa mojada».
p.tambor.consejo: In a washing machine it is the drum. It is also the musical instrument.
p.técnico.consejo: Feminine: «la técnica». It has an accent on the first syllable.
p.arrodilla.consejo: It comes from «rodilla», knee. Reflexive: «se arrodilla».
p.parte.consejo: «La parte de abajo» is the lower part. Another use: «parte» of «partir».
p.abajo.consejo: The j sounds like h. Its opposite is «arriba».
p.cubo.consejo: In Spain «cubo» is a bucket. It also means a cube.
p.funcionará.consejo: Future of «funcionar». The accent marks the last syllable.
p.quejarse.consejo: Reflexive verb: «me quejo, te quejas». It goes with «de».
